tasks.label: Release build
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cmake --preset gcc-release && cmake --build --preset gcc-release

tasks.label: Debug build
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cmake --preset gcc-debug && cmake --build --preset gcc-debug

tasks.label: Debug tests
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cmake --preset coverage && cmake --build --preset coverage
